question:
A class has $100$ students. Let $a_i$, $1\le i\le100$, denote the number of friends the $i$-th student has in the class. For each $0\le j\le99$, let $c_j$ denote the number of students having at least $j$ friends. Show that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{100}a_i=\sum_{j=0}^{99}c_j.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
